data.long_meaning: The name Almund is derived from the Old German word 'alah' meaning 'all' and 'mund' meaning 'protection' or 'ruler'. This name was often given to children who were considered to be a guardian or protector, reflecting the idea of God's protection and care.

in_greek.name: Αλμουνδ
